chapter: England, Paris and memories of Kansas City and Harlem
title: Playing Paris concert halls and Boeuf sur le Toit
summary: In Paris she made more money than ever, playing concert halls and the Boeuf sur le Toit as a solo act.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: What did you do in Paris?
I played there a while. I made probably more money than I've ever made in my life.
I played all the concert halls there including an engagement with about 10 classical pianists. I can't remember the names of those places. I played the Boeuf sur le Tait, a night club.
